occ.birthday.name: Sngi kha
occ.birthday.headline: Khublei shibun ia ka sngi kha
occ.birthday.message: Ngi kitbok kitrwiang ia phi ba phin ioh ia ka snem kaba dap da ka jingkmen, ka jingkoit jingkhiah bad ka jingjop. To ai ba ki jingangnud jong phi baroh kin urlong.
occ.anniversary.name: Ka jingrakhe snem shongkurim
occ.anniversary.headline: Khublei shibun ia ka sngi rakhe
occ.anniversary.message: Ngi kitbok kitrwiang ia phi baroh arngut ia ka jingim jong ka jingieid, jingiatylli bad jingkmen. Khublei shibun ia kane ka sngi kaba itynnad.
occ.wedding.name: Jingkhawai shongkurim
occ.wedding.headline: Ka jingim shongkha shongman kaba suk
occ.wedding.message: Khublei shibun eh ia ka jingkhawai shongkurim jong phi. To ai ba ka jingiaid lynti jong phi ryngkat kan long kaba dap da ka jingieid, jingshaniah bad jingkmen bym kut.
occ.work-anniversary.name: Ka jingrakhe snem trei
occ.work-anniversary.headline: Khublei shibun ia ka sngi trei kam
occ.work-anniversary.message: Khublei shibun ia kawei pat ka snem jong ka jingaiti bad ka jingtrei kaba khraw. Khublei shibun ia baroh kaba phi wanrah sha ka kynhun.
occ.business-anniversary.name: Ka jingrakhe snem jong ka kam
occ.business-anniversary.headline: Khublei shibun ia ka jingrakhe ia ka kam khaii
occ.business-anniversary.message: Khublei shibun ia kawei pat ka snem kaba jop. Khublei shibun ia ka jingshaniah bad jingiatreilang jong phi — hangne ​​sha ki snem kiba kham bun jong ka jingroi.
occ.inauguration.name: Ka jingplie dukan / ophis
occ.inauguration.headline: Khublei shibun ia ka jingsdang bathymmai jong phi .
occ.inauguration.message: Ka jingkitbok kitrwiang ha ka jingplie paidbah. To ai ba ka jingthmu thymmai jong phi kan wanrah ia ka jingroi jingpar, ka jingroi bad ka jingjop kaba khraw.
occ.congratulations.name: Khublei shibun
occ.congratulations.headline: Khublei shibun
occ.congratulations.message: Khublei shibun ia ka jingjop jong phi. Ka jingtrei shitom bad ka jingaiti lut jong phi ka pynshlur shisha ia ngi baroh.
occ.thank-you.name: Khublei shibun
occ.thank-you.headline: Khublei shibun
occ.thank-you.message: Khublei shibun ia ka jingshaniah bad jingkyrshan jong phi. Ngi sngewnguh shisha ban don ia phi ryngkat bad ngi.
occ.get-well-soon.name: To koit noh kloi
occ.get-well-soon.headline: To koit noh kloi
occ.get-well-soon.message: Ngi kitbok kitrwiang ia phi ba phin koit noh kloi. To sumar bha bad to ioh biang ia ka jingkoit jingkhiah kaba bha kloi bha.
occ.housewarming.name: Ka jingpynlong ia ka iing (Griha Pravesh)
occ.housewarming.headline: Khublei ia u Griha Pravesh
occ.housewarming.message: Khublei shibun ia ka iing thymmai jong phi. To kan long kaba dap da ka jingsuk, jingieid, jingkmen bad jingroi jingpar.
occ.new-baby.name: U Khunlung bathymmai
occ.new-baby.headline: Pdiang sngewbha, Khun rit
occ.new-baby.message: Khublei shibun eh ia ka jingwan jong ka kynhun jingkmen barit jong phi. Ka jingkitbok kitrwiang ia u khunlung ba un koit un khiah bad un suk ha ka jingim jong u.
occ.retirement.name: Ka jingshongthait kaba suk
occ.retirement.headline: Ka jingshongthait kaba suk
occ.retirement.message: Khublei shibun ia ka kam kaba phylla. Ngi kitbok kitrwiang ia phi ia ka lynnong thymmai jong ka jingim kaba suk, kaba koit ba khiah bad kaba kmen.
occ.best-wishes.name: Ki jingkyrkhu kyrdoh
occ.best-wishes.headline: Ki jingkyrkhu kyrdoh
occ.best-wishes.message: Ngi phah ia ka jingkyrkhu kyrdoh jong ngi na ka bynta ka jingkmen, ka jingkoit jingkhiah bad ka jingjop ha kiei kiei baroh kiba phi leh.
occ.new-year.name: Snem thymmai
occ.new-year.headline: Khublei snem thymmai
occ.new-year.message: To ai ba une u snem thymmai un wanrah ia phi ia ki jingkyrmen kiba thymmai, ki lad ki lynti kiba thymmai bad ka jingjop kaba bun. Ngi kitbok kitrwiang ia phi bad ia ka iing ka sem jong phi ia ka snem kaba itynnad ban wan.
occ.republic-day.name: Sngi jong ka Ri
occ.republic-day.headline: Khublei ia ka Sngi Republic
occ.republic-day.message: To ngin rakhe ia ka mynsiem jong ka Riti Synshar jong ngi bad ia ka jingsarong ban long ki nong India. Jai Hind.
occ.independence-day.name: Sngi laitluid
occ.independence-day.headline: Khublei shibun ia ka sngi laitluid
occ.independence-day.message: Ka jingai khublei ia ki riewshlur kiba la ai ia ngi ia ka jinglaitluid. To ai ba ka jaitbynriew jong ngi kan nang kiew ha ka bor bad ka jingiatylli. Jai Hind.
occ.gandhi-jayanti.name: U Gandhi Jayanti
occ.gandhi-jayanti.headline: Khublei shibun ia u Gandhi
occ.gandhi-jayanti.message: Da kaba kynmaw ia u Kpa ka Jaitbynriew. To ai ba ki jingmut jong u jong ka jingshisha bad ka jingbymleh donbor kin ialam ia ngi man ka por.
occ.ambedkar-jayanti.name: Ambedkar Jayanti
occ.ambedkar-jayanti.headline: Khublei shibun ia ka sngi Ambedkar
occ.ambedkar-jayanti.message: Da kaba ai burom ia u Dr. B. R. Ambedkar, u nongshna ia ka Riti Synshar jong ngi. To ai ba ka jingïohi jong u ïa ka jingïaryngkat bad ka hok kan ai mynsiem ïa ngi.
occ.kisan-diwas.name: Sngi jong ki nongrep ha ka ri baroh kawei (Kisan Diwas)
occ.kisan-diwas.headline: Khublei Kisan Diwas
occ.kisan-diwas.message: Ka jingai khublei ia ki nongrep jong ngi, ka ryndang jong ka jaitbynriew jong ngi. Khublei shibun ia ka jingtrei shitom jong phi kaba ai bam ia ngi baroh.
occ.teachers-day.name: Sngi ki Nonghikai
occ.teachers-day.headline: Khublei shibun ia ki nonghikai
occ.teachers-day.message: Khublei shibun ba phi la ialam, ai mynsiem bad pynwan dur ia ka lawei jong ngi. Khublei Sngi Ki Nonghikai.
occ.childrens-day.name: Sngi jong ki khynnah
occ.childrens-day.headline: Khublei ia ka sngi jong ki khynnah
occ.childrens-day.message: Ka jingrakhe ia ka jingkmen, ka jinglong khlem pop bad ka lawei kaba phyrnai jong uwei pa uwei u khynnah. Khublei ia ka sngi ki khynnah.
occ.womens-day.name: Sngi jong ki kynthei
occ.womens-day.headline: Khublei shibun ia ka sngi jong ki kynthei
occ.womens-day.message: Ka jingrakhe ia ka bor, ka jingaiei bad ki jingjop jong ki kynthei ha man la ki jaka. Khublei shibun ia ka sngi jong ki kynthei.
occ.mothers-day.name: Sngi jong ki kmie
occ.mothers-day.headline: Khublei shibun ia ka sngi jong ki kmie
occ.mothers-day.message: Ha uba ai jingieit bad jingsumar bym kut — Khublei Sngi Kmie.
occ.fathers-day.name: Ka Sngi U Kpa
occ.fathers-day.headline: Khublei shibun ia ka sngi jong u kpa
occ.fathers-day.message: Ha u mawjam jong ka bor bad jingpyniaid jong ngi — Khublei Sngi U Kpa.
occ.doctors-day.name: Ka sngi jong ki doktor ka ri
occ.doctors-day.headline: Khublei shibun ia ka sngi jong ki doktor
occ.doctors-day.message: Khublei shibun ia ka jingaiti, jingsumar bad jingshakri jong phi ia ka longbriew manbriew. Khublei shibun ia ka sngi ki doktor jong ka ri.
occ.friendship-day.name: Ka Sngi Jingialok
occ.friendship-day.headline: Khublei shibun ia ka sngi paralok
occ.friendship-day.message: Khublei shibun ba phi long u paralok ba sngewtynnad. Hangne ​​ka don ka jingiadei jong ngi bad bun kiwei pat ki jingkynmaw kiba kmen.
occ.diwali.name: Ka Diwali
occ.diwali.headline: Khublei ia ka Diwali
occ.diwali.message: Ai ba ka tamasa jong ki sharak kan wanrah ia ka roi ka par, ka jingkmen bad ka jingkoit jingkhiah ia phi bad ia ka iing ka sem jong phi.
occ.dhanteras.name: U Dhanteras
occ.dhanteras.headline: Khublei shibun ia ka sngi Dhanteras
occ.dhanteras.message: To ai ba ka Blei Lakshmi bad U Blei Dhanvantari kin kyrkhu ia phi da ka spah ka phew, ka jingkoit jingkhiah bad ka roi ka par.
occ.diwali-padwa.name: Ka Diwali Padwa / Balipratipada
occ.diwali-padwa.headline: Khublei ia ka Diwali Padwa
occ.diwali-padwa.message: Ngi kitbok kitrwiang ia phi ia ka jingsdang thymmai kaba suk kaba dap da ka jingieid, jingkmen bad jingjop.
occ.bhai-dooj.name: Bhai Dooj / Bhaubeej .
occ.bhai-dooj.headline: Khublei Bhai Dooj
occ.bhai-dooj.message: Ka jingrakhe ia ka jingiadei kaba kordor hapdeng ki hynmen bad ki para. Ngi kitbok kitrwiang ia phi ia ka jingieid, jingiada bad jingkmen.
occ.holi.name: Holi
occ.holi.headline: Khublei shibun ia ka Holi
occ.holi.message: To ai ba ki rong ba itynnad jong ka Holi kin pyndap ia ka jingim jong phi da ka jingkmen, jingieid bad jingroi jingpar.
occ.navratri.name: Ka sngi Sngi
occ.navratri.headline: Khublei ia ka Navratri
occ.navratri.message: To ai ba ka Maa Durga kan kyrkhu ia phi da ka bor, ka jingstad bad ka jingkmen ha kine ki hynniew miet kiba bha.
occ.dussehra.name: Ka Sngi Dussehra
occ.dussehra.headline: Khublei Dusseh
occ.dussehra.message: To ai ba ka jingjop jong ka jingbha halor ka jingsniew kan ai mynsiem ia phi ban ioh ia ka jingjop ha man la ka jingpyrshang.
occ.ganesh-chaturthi.name: U Ganesh Chaturthi
occ.ganesh-chaturthi.headline: Khublei shibun ia u Ganesh
occ.ganesh-chaturthi.message: To U Trai Ganesha un weng noh ia ki jingkhanglad baroh na ka lynti jong phi bad un kyrkhu ia phi da ka jingstad bad jingroi jingpar. Ganpati Bappa Morya.
occ.raksha-bandhan.name: Raksha Bandhan
occ.raksha-bandhan.headline: Khublei Raksha Bandhan
occ.raksha-bandhan.message: Ka jingrakhe ia ka jingiadei kaba itynnad jong ka jingieit bad jingiada hapdeng ki hynmen bad ki para.
occ.janmashtami.name: Janmashtami
occ.janmashtami.headline: Khublei Janmashtami
occ.janmashtami.message: To U Trai Krishna un pyndap ia ka jingim jong phi da ka jingieid, ka jingkmen bad ki jingkyrkhu ba kynja Blei.
occ.makar-sankranti.name: Makar Sankranti
occ.makar-sankranti.headline: Khublei shibun ia u Makar Sankranti
occ.makar-sankranti.message: To ai ba kane ka tamasa ot kan wanrah ia ka jingsngewtynnat, jingkmen bad jingroi jingpar ha ka jingim jong phi.
occ.maha-shivratri.name: Maha Shivratri
occ.maha-shivratri.headline: Khublei ia ka Maha Shivratri
occ.maha-shivratri.message: To U Blei Shiva un kyrkhu ia phi da ka jingsuk, ka bor bad ka jingkmen. Har Har Mahadev.
occ.ram-navami.name: U Ram Navami
occ.ram-navami.headline: Khublei shibun ia ka Ram Navami
occ.ram-navami.message: To ai ba ki jingkyrkhu jong U Trai Rama kin wanrah ia phi ia ka jingshisha, ka hok bad ka jingkmen.
occ.hanuman-jayanti.name: U Hanuman
occ.hanuman-jayanti.headline: Khublei shibun ia u Hanuman
occ.hanuman-jayanti.message: To U Trai Hanuman un kyrkhu ia phi da ka jingshlur, ka jingkhlain bad ka jingaiti lut.
occ.vasant-panchami.name: Ka Jingrwai
occ.vasant-panchami.headline: Khublei shibun ia ka sngi Vasant
occ.vasant-panchami.message: To ai ba ka Blei Saraswati kan kyrkhu ia phi da ka jingnang jingstad, jingstad bad jingstad.
occ.guru-purnima.name: U Guru Purnima
occ.guru-purnima.headline: Ka jingkhublei Guru purnima
occ.guru-purnima.message: Da ka jingsngewnguh ia baroh ki nonghikai bad ki nongpyniaid jong ngi kiba pynshai ia ka lynti jong ka jingnang jingstad.
occ.akshaya-tritiya.name: Akshaya Tritiya
occ.akshaya-tritiya.headline: Khublei ia ka Akshaya Tritia
occ.akshaya-tritiya.message: To ai ba kane ka sngi kaba bha kan wanrah ia ka jingroi jingpar, jingjop bad jingkmen bym kut ia phi.
occ.karva-chauth.name: Karba Chauth
occ.karva-chauth.headline: Khublei shibun ia ka sngi Karva
occ.karva-chauth.message: Ngi kitbok kitrwiang ia phi ia ka Karva Chauth kaba kyrkhu kaba dap da ka jingieid bad ka jingiatylli.
occ.chhath-puja.name: Ka jingleh niam
occ.chhath-puja.headline: Khublei shibun ia ka jinglehniam Chhath puja
occ.chhath-puja.message: To Chhathi Maiya bad ka Sngi U Blei un kyrkhu ia phi bad ia ka iing ka sem jong phi da ka koit ka khiah bad ka roi ka par.
occ.nag-panchami.name: Na ka Panchami
occ.nag-panchami.headline: Khublei ia ka sngi rakhe Nag Pancha
occ.nag-panchami.message: To ai ba kane ka sngi ba kyntang kan wanrah ia phi ka jingiada, ka jingsuk bad ka roi ka par.
occ.tulsi-vivah.name: Tulsi Vivah
occ.tulsi-vivah.headline: Khublei Tulsi Vivah
occ.tulsi-vivah.message: To ai ba ka jingiasoh blei jong ka Tulsi bad U Blei Vishnu kan kyrkhu ia ka iing jong phi da ka jingkmen bad jingsuk.
occ.eid-ul-fitr.name: Ka jinglehniam Eid
occ.eid-ul-fitr.headline: Ka Eid Mubarak
occ.eid-ul-fitr.message: Ai ba kane ka Eid kan wanrah ia ka jingsuk, jingkmen bad jingroi jingpar ia phi bad kiba ieid ba thoin jong phi.
occ.eid-ul-adha.name: Eid al-adha (bakrid)
occ.eid-ul-adha.headline: Ka Eid al-Adha
occ.eid-ul-adha.message: To ai ba ki jingkyrkhu jong U Allah kin pyndap ia ka jingim jong phi da ka jingkmen bad plie ia ki jingkhang baroh jong ka jingjop.
occ.milad-un-nabi.name: Milad-un-Nabi
occ.milad-un-nabi.headline: Ka Eid Milad-un-Nabi Mubarak
occ.milad-un-nabi.message: To ai ba kane ka sngi ba kyrkhu kan pyndap ia ka dohnud jong phi da ka jingsuk, jingieid bad jingsngewrit.
occ.christmas.name: Khristmas
occ.christmas.headline: Khrismas ba kmen
occ.christmas.message: Ngi kitbok kitrwiang ia phi ia ka Khristmas kaba kmen kaba dap da ka jingieid, jingsuk bad jingkmen, bad ka snem kaba phylla ha khmat.
occ.easter.name: Ka Paskha
occ.easter.headline: Khublei ia ka Easter
occ.easter.message: Ai ba ka jingkmen bad jingkyrmen jong ka Easter kan pyndap ia ka dohnud bad ka iing jong phi.
occ.guru-nanak-jayanti.name: U Guru Nanak Jayanti (Gurpurab)
occ.guru-nanak-jayanti.headline: Khublei Gurpurab
occ.guru-nanak-jayanti.message: To ai ba ki jinghikai jong u Guru Nanak Dev Ji kin ialam ia phi sha ka jingsuk, ka jingshisha bad ka jingbhabriew.
occ.guru-gobind-singh-jayanti.name: U Guru Gobind Singh Jayanti
occ.guru-gobind-singh-jayanti.headline: Khublei shibun ia u Guru Gobind Singh Jayant
occ.guru-gobind-singh-jayanti.message: Ai ba ka jingshlur bad ka jingstad jong u Guru Gobind Singh Ji kan ai mynsiem ia ngi baroh.
occ.buddha-purnima.name: U Buddha purnima
occ.buddha-purnima.headline: Khublei shibun ia u Buddha purnima
occ.buddha-purnima.message: To ai ba ki jinghikai jong u Trai Buddha kin wanrah ia ka jingsuk, jingsngewrit bad jingstad ha ka jingim jong phi.
occ.mahavir-jayanti.name: Mahavir Jayanti
occ.mahavir-jayanti.headline: Khublei ia u Mahavir Jayant
occ.mahavir-jayanti.message: To ai ba ki jinghikai jong u Trai Mahavir jong ka jingbym leh donbor bad ka jingshisha kin wanrah ia ka jingsuk ha ka jingim jong phi.
occ.paryushan.name: Ka Jingiaseng / Samvatsari
occ.paryushan.headline: Michhami Dukkadam
occ.paryushan.message: Lada nga la pynmong ia phi ha kano kano ka rukom, da kaba tip ne khlem tip, lyngba ka jingpyrkhat, ka ktien ne ka jingleh, nga pan map na phi.
occ.navroz.name: Snem Thymmai ki Parsi (Navroz)
occ.navroz.headline: Navroz Mubarak
occ.navroz.message: Ngi kitbok kitrwiang ia phi ia ka snem thymmai jong ki Parsi kaba dap da ka jingkmen, ka jingkoit jingkhiah bad ka jingroi jingpar.
occ.lohri.name: Lohri
occ.lohri.headline: Khublei Lohri
occ.lohri.message: To ai ba ka jingshit jong ka ding Lohri kan wanrah ia ka jingkmen, ka jingroi jingpar bad ka jingot kaba bun.
occ.baisakhi.name: Baisakhi
occ.baisakhi.headline: Khublei shibun ia ka Baisakhi
occ.baisakhi.message: To ai ba kane ka jingkhawai ot kan pyndap ia ka jingim jong phi da ka jingbun, ka jingkmen bad ka jingroi jingpar.
occ.teej.name: Teej Hariyali
occ.teej.headline: Khublei Teej
occ.teej.message: To ai ba ka Blei Parvati kan kyrkhu ia phi da ka jingieid, jingkmen bad jingroi jingpar.
occ.gudi-padwa.name: Gudi Padwa
occ.gudi-padwa.headline: Khublei Gudi Padwa
occ.gudi-padwa.message: To ai ba une u snem thymmai Marathi un wanrah ia phi ia ki jingkyrmen ba thymmai, ka jingjop bad ka jingroi jingpar.
occ.ugadi.name: Ugadi
occ.ugadi.headline: Khublei Ugadi

occ.rath-yatra.headline: Khublei ia ka Rath Yatra
